Summary: Persistent Cleanup Profiles for developers, video editors, and system maintenance. 1-click batch cleanup with zero hard deletion.
Added: Persistent Cleanup Profiles: Tailored cleanup presets for Software Developers (node_modules, bin/obj, package caches, Android/Gradle), Video Editors (DaVinci/Premiere render caches, untouched media), and General Maintenance.
Custom Profile Creator: Build custom cleanup suites with 9 selectable target categories, minimum age and size thresholds, and exclusion lists.
